title: Data-Centric AI: Interval Estimation via Calibrated Synthetic Validation
summary: A master's-thesis research framework that generates synthetic validation data (via CTGAN, TVAE, TabPFN, Gaussian Copula) and calibrates it with ridge-regression sample weights to give theoretically-grounded confidence intervals for ML model selection on limited labeled data. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) as three of its core synthetic data generators.
